notes: Exercises GS V 66, the cut with a feed, on a profile without an autocutter. The case names the NT-5890K profile, whose printable_width_dots is 384. It cuts the stream into two sheets of 134 dots together against 147 here, because a cut is an item here and a sheet boundary there.
